Summons Rorola, resonating with the power of ancestors to gain a damage boost for some time. Also, every 10 hits on targets grant an additional damage boost, stacking up to 5 times. Once the cap is reached, subsequent hits extend the duration of the additional boost (the duration of the Base DMG boost does not extend). Each extension adds 3s, with a maximum of 5 extensions. At the same time, grants the Life Steal effect, restoring HP equal to a portion of damage dealt (the duration can extend). This skill holds 2 charges.

Transforms into Dorothy, replacing basic attack modules and gaining Artisan's Power. Passive: Dealing damage has a 40% chance to trigger Chain Lightning (trigger interval: at least 0.5s). ① Charges and fires a powerful shot at the target, dealing Attack DMG. Each additional charge increases the damage by 150%. ② Leaps into the air and launches a Thunderstorm Bolt at the target, dealing Attack DMG and creating a Thunderstorm Zone at the target for 7s. Thunderstorm Zone deals Attack DMG per second to enemies within and slows them. ③ Continuously unleashes Thunder Tracers, dealing Attack DMG and inflicting Paralysis on hit. ④ Fires an Oblivion Bomb, which explodes after traveling a distance or upon impact, dealing Attack DMG.

Summons Fafala to create a field. You and allies within the field gain Final DMG Reduction and Super Armor. When you take damage, reduce the CD of this Skill by 1s (can trigger at most once every 2s). [This effect does not stack. Only one instance of this effect can be active at a time.

Performing a Special Attack extends this bonus's duration by 3s, up to a max of 5 times (The ATK bonus's duration is not affected). This skill holds 2 charges.
